imtihonlar.qiymat: SAT yoki ACT ixtiyoriy (test optional); ingliz tili imtihoni (EPT) ixtiyoriy, ona tili ingliz tili bo'lmagan va 2 yildan kam ingliz tilida o'qiganlarga tavsiya etiladi
imtihonlar.manba_iborasi: Submission of English proficiency testing (EPT) is optional.

xalqaro_yordam_turi.qiymat: Ehtiyojga asoslangan (need-based) yordam, raqobat juda kuchli; cheklangan sondagi merit stipendiya (Charles J. Turck Presidential Honor Scholarship)
xalqaro_yordam_turi.manba_iborasi: Applicants for financial assistance should be aware that all awards are based on need and that the competition for these funds is extremely keen.

deadline.qiymat: Regular Decision: 15-yanvar; Early Decision I va Early Action: 1-noyabr; Early Decision II: 1-yanvar
